component.name: YAFC-CE
component.summary: A planner and analyzer for Factorio

description.p: YAFC is more than just a calculator. It uses multiple algorithms to understand what is going on in your modpack to the point of calculating the whole late-game base. It knows what items are more important and what recipes are more efficient.
It was created as an answer to recursive Pyanodon recipes that tools like Helmod could not handle. YAFC uses Google's OrTools as a model solver to handle them extremely well.
YAFC also has its own Never Enough Items, which is FNEI on steroids. In addition to showing the recipes, it shows which ones you want to use and how much.
